paragraphs: Rav Huna, son of Rav Yehoshua, Berakhot 22b.
Rav Chinana, son of Rav Yehoshua, Pesachim 110b.
Rav Nechemyah, son of Rav Yehoshua, Moed Katan 19b.
Rav Shisha or Sheshet, son of Rav Yehoshua, Pesachim 115.

notes.text: The list’s ר״י refers contextually to the heading Rav Yehoshua. This does not establish that all listed men had the same father. The final Pesachim folio has no side supplied.

The consulted Moed Katan paragraph also gives an alternative in which Nechemyah is the son of Rav Yosef. The consulted Pesachim 115a has Sheshet. The supplied notice leaves the side unspecified and gives both Shisha and Sheshet.
